skill.summary: 中文网页搜索 - 聚合 17 个免费搜索引擎，无需 API Key，纯网页抓取，支持公众号/财经/技术/学术/知识搜索。

latestVersion.changelog:
cn-web-search-custom 1.0.0

- Initial release: aggregate search across 13+ free Chinese search engines.
- No API key required; all engines are free to use.
- Supports multi-category search: WeChat Official Accounts, Zhihu, finance (A-shares), technical search, and more.
- Pure web scraping approach for fetching results.
